card.name: "Cases of" opening adverse-event statements
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after the sentence-opening word "Cases" in warning text, as in "Cases of adrenal insufficiency have been reported". It also fires weakly on "a" in "sometimes after a short exposure".

modes.label: Cases of [condition]
modes.description: "of" directly after a sentence-initial "Cases", introducing a reported adverse condition.
modes.example: Adrenal Insufficiency Cases<< of>> adrenal insufficiency have been reported with

modes.label: After a short exposure
modes.description: "a" after "sometimes after" in a report of a reaction following brief drug use.
modes.example: sometimes after<< a>> short exposure (<2 weeks). TTP

card.writes: It seems to steer away from words like incident and case, since the case-type word has already been used.
